summary: Milestone Scientific Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 7,962,963 units at $0.27 per unit, each consisting of one share of common stock and one warrant exercisable at $0.3375 per share for three years. Gross proceeds were $2.15 million ($1.799M cash plus $351K note conversion); full warrant exercise could yield an additional $2.6875M. Directors/officers participated. No placement agent was used; proceeds are for working capital. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
